articles.summary: Fusion isn't built by physicists alone. Meet the technicians assembling Helion's fusion generators and find out what it takes to join them.
articles.title: The technicians building fusion

articles.summary: What materials can support a star on Earth? At Helion, they determine whether a fusion machine survives extreme heat, radiation, and mechanical stress, pulse after pulse.
articles.title: What it takes to build materials for a fusion machine
